title: Ninja Sneaking R
description:
Ninja Sneaking is now powered up after 11 years!

Idiot girl who invaded the enemy's castle. Kunoichi.

Quickly conquer all 100 stages without being spotted by the enemy.



Number of players: 1 to 4

Game Rules: Aim for the goal without being found by enemies.





"Operation Methods"



Controller (XBOX type controller recommended)



Left stick: Move left/right

A button: Jump

X button: Crawl / Stick to the ceiling

B button: Head sliding

Y button: Attack

Start button: Menu display





Keyboard operation (If a controller is not connected, the keyboard can be used to operate the controller.)



A/D: Move left/right

Space: Jump

Enter: Creeping/Ceiling

Ctrl: Head sliding

Shift: Attack

Tab: Menu display
